text: juvo-web auto-chat (verified 10-5, master 2e3300b0): ONE canned message per company_location (automated_reply_message + automated_reply_time_of_day), posted by a super_admin 'system user' (ENV AUTOMATED_SUBMISSION_RESPONSE_SYSTEM_USER) via rake automated_submission_replies within 25h of a pending connection; no preload flag exists, 'real employer' = a LocationAdmin attached; Debbie's desk = /dash…

juvo-web notifications (verified 10-5): seeker-facing events are FCM push only; seekers get NO email for connection/chat events (only a SendGrid welcome template); SendGrid = SMTP relay + employer mailers, sender admin@juvoapp.com. No partner API or webhooks: an outside system can only act as the seeker (POST /users, /users/sign_in JWT 14d, POST /api/v3/connections).

juvo-web GitHub master last commit 2025-07-07, Mike Shutt the only committer; confirm master == what runs in prod before trusting code reads. Juvo staging is app-staging.juvojobs.com; monitoring is Sentry + Better Stack (New Relic gem absent).

jobsnearme corpus keeps Juvo ids: job_postings.source_key = Juvo job id, company_locations.source_key = Juvo location id (scripts/ingest-juvo-jobs.mjs:264-274) - enough to POST /api/v3/connections {company_location_id, job_ids} for a bridge.

jobsnearme go-live: where does Connect on a Juvo posting go? Bridge into Juvo's own auto-chat + Debbie's desk via Juvo's API (no juvo-web change, hand-off fallback), our own staff desk (cloud plan D1b), or hand-off only?

jobsnearme bridge: the Juvo account we create per seeker uses a relay address we control (no clash with existing Juvo accounts, real email never reaches a Juvo employer) or the seeker's real email (clash = hand-off)?
jobsnearme launch shape: soft-live Fri 10/9 in Atlanta and public Mon 10/12 (about 6 days of numbers by the 15th), or the cloud plan's soft 10/13, public 10/15?
jobsnearme hosting: start Heroku in our own account tomorrow and transfer the apps to Juvo's team later, or wait for Juvo's team access?
jobsnearme legal: Juvo's privacy policy and terms plus a short JobsNearMe addendum that Raj reviews, or fresh drafts?
jobsnearme day-1 traffic for real numbers: Juvo's own channels (app users, juvojobs.com, a list email) plus Mark's soft cohort, the cohort only, or also Meta/Muse organic?
jobsnearme employers at launch: close JobsNearMe employer self-signup (real employers stay in Juvo's portal), or invite-only JobsNearMe employer accounts?

jobsnearme GL-Q1 (10-5): Connect on Juvo postings bridges into Juvo's own system via its existing API (auto-chat + Debbie's desk), hand-off 'Continue in Juvo' built first as fallback; the bridge is interim until everyone moves into the JobsNearMe network.
jobsnearme GL-Q2 (10-5): the Juvo account the bridge creates per seeker uses a relay address we control, not the seeker's real email.
jobsnearme GL-Q3 (10-5): soft launch Fri 2026-10-09 in Atlanta, public Mon 2026-10-12; only the meeting's small UI touch-ups, no major UI/UX changes.
jobsnearme GL-Q4 (10-5): Heroku starts in Alex's own account now; apps transfer to Juvo's Heroku team later.
jobsnearme GL-Q5 (10-5): legal = Juvo's privacy policy and terms plus a JobsNearMe addendum, Raj reviews; Alex to confirm with Mark.
jobsnearme GL-Q7 (10-5): JobsNearMe employer self-signup closed at launch; real employers stay in Juvo's portal; employer signup moves fully to JobsNearMe at the full go-live.

jobsnearme process for the launch (10-5): fast gate on push to staging, full e2e nightly and before each prod promote (local certify counts); one sonnet critic round per spec, Codex packet per lane per day (not per spec), one Grok red team on the launch path Sat 10-10; the in_review backlog frozen until after 10-15. Four lanes: L1 platform, L2 Connect bridge, L3 seeker path, L4 trust + data.

jobsnearme hosting-alternatives analysis (Mark asked about Azure or another environment): background sonnet research agent writes docs/10-architecture/hosting-alternatives.md with pros/cons and a recommendation.
